hero.subtitle: Race the same course as every other player. Collect all 10 apples, dodge the water and walls, and post the fastest verified time.

features.title: Built for fair competition
features.subtitle: Every racer gets the same map, the same apples and the same rules. Only skill decides the podium.

sameCourse.title: Identical courses
sameCourse.body: Same map, start position, apple layout and speed for every participant.

verified.title: Verified results
verified.body: Every run is replayed on the server. Times sent straight from a browser are never trusted.

private.title: Private games
private.body: Host a match for 2–20 friends with an invite link or access code. No approval needed.

coins.title: Snake Coins
coins.body: Earn coins for finishing and placing. Redeem them for power-ups and free spins.

join.title: Join
join.body: Pick a public competition or enter a private access code.

race.title: Race
race.body: Collect all apples. Water slows you, walls end the run.

retry.title: Retry
retry.body: Unlimited attempts during the competition window.

rank.title: Rank
rank.body: Your best verified time sets your leaderboard position.

rewards.title: Rewards that keep you racing
rewards.note: Snake Coins are virtual, non-transferable and have no cash value.

cta.title: Ready to race?
cta.body: Create a free account and join your first competition.

fields.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers or underscores. Shown on leaderboards.
fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
fields.acceptTerms: I understand Snake Race Arena is free to play, with no cash prizes, and Snake Coins have no cash value.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join free and start racing in minutes.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.
verify.bodyNoEmail: We sent a verification link to your email. Click it to activate your account.
verify.hint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.
verify.resent: If an account needs verifying, a new email is on its way.
verify.linkInvalid: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

errors.usernameChars: Use only letters, numbers and underscores.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken or not allowed.
errors.passwordStrength: Password needs at least one letter and one number.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.resetLinkExpired: Your reset link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.notConfigured: Authentication isn't configured yet. Add your Supabase keys to .env.local.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Player Dashboard
dashboard.verifiedBanner: Email verified. Your account is ready!
dashboard.suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

stats.title: My stats
stats.empty: Stats appear after your first race.

courseDesc.training-grounds: A compact course that introduces water, bridges, a tunnel and every power-up.
courseDesc.neon-valley: A winding river, three bridges, two crossing tunnels and tight rock clusters.

game.practiceBadge: Practice mode — times are not ranked

powerups.title: Power-ups
powerups.magnetDesc: Pulls in apples within 2 cells for 5 seconds.
powerups.energyDesc: Swim at full speed for 6 seconds.

controls.title: Controls
controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to steer
controls.touch: Swipe on the board or use the pad

ready.title: Get ready
ready.goal: Collect all {count} apples as fast as you can.
ready.rules: Your snake stays the same length. Walls, rocks and your own body end the run.

arena.title: Game Arena
arena.subtitle: Warm up on a practice course. Ranked competitions open in the next update.
arena.competitionsSoon: Public and private competitions with verified leaderboards are coming next.

footer.rights: © {year} Snake Race Arena. All rights reserved.
footer.disclaimer: Free to play. No paid entry, no cash prizes.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This area is being built in {phase}.
